determinism_gate.post_hoc_disclosure: ⛔ THE 7.2 GATE WAS NOT RUN BEFORE THE QUALITY CELLS, AS 7.2 REQUIRES. gate4_run.py never performed it; the Stage 2 results audit found the omission and it was run on 2026-09-13, AFTER Stage 1 and Stage 2 had completed. The protocol's ordering was therefore violated, and no PASS recorded here can undo that. What a post-hoc self-vs-self probe cannot establish is that the PERSISTED Stage 1 waveforms are reproducible - which is why retro_sha_check below exists.
what_it_does_not_cover: determinism across processes, drivers or machines
the ENCODER (7.2 holds the representation fixed)

retro_sha_check.purpose: M3. Re-decode a declared, deterministic, outcome-blind sample of the ACTUAL Stage 1 cells and compare against the persisted waveforms.
two_guarantees: FILE INTEGRITY: the persisted file still hashes to the Stage 1 manifest value, so the bytes Stage 2 measured are unaltered
DECODE REPRODUCIBILITY: re-decoding the same cell through the frozen path yields BIT-IDENTICAL samples
retro_sha_check.why_not_the_file_hash: a libsndfile WAV stamps a CREATION TIMESTAMP into its PEAK chunk (3 bytes at offset 60), so a rewrite never reproduces the file hash even when every sample is identical; sample-level hashing is the only valid reproduction test
retro_sha_check.cold_start_finding: fish_modified_dac's FIRST inference after model load can differ from its warm output (max|d| 4.82e-02, reproducible). Stage 1 decoded all 1736 cells per arm in ONE process, so at most the FIRST cell of a process was ever exposed; that cell (Speaker_01/Neutral/902) was re-decoded cold and reproduces BIT-IDENTICALLY. Probes are warmed to reproduce Stage 1's own state.

streaming_detector.what_Q1_is: DETECTOR. The streamed output against THIS ARM'S OWN full-context decode. Never a cross-decoder quality claim, never a severity scale (amendment 6).

floor_uncertainty.method: bootstrap the state's own 16 frozen draws from fuzz_gate4_lib.json, take the same 0.95 quantile inside each resample, read the 2.5/97.5 percentiles

⛔ floor_hi IS SATURATED.finding: floor_hi equals the MAXIMUM of the 16 draws EXACTLY, in all six states. A 0.95 quantile of a resample cannot exceed the sample maximum, so the bootstrap is pinned by construction.
⛔ floor_hi IS SATURATED.consequence: FLOOR_BOOT_RESAMPLES and FLOOR_BOOT_SEED change nothing - two of the four SPEC S7.1 constants are DECORATIVE. Measured: SD 0.0000 across 41 seeds and identical under all five numpy quantile methods.
⛔ floor_hi IS SATURATED.what_it_means: the ROBUST / FLOOR_FRAGILE boundary is a SINGLE EXTREME FUZZ DRAW, not a distribution.

floor_uncertainty.⚠️ rng_is_reseeded_per_state: floor_uncertainty() creates the generator inside the per-state loop, so all six states draw IDENTICAL resample indices. Recorded, not changed: the statistic is saturated, so it alters nothing, and changing the method after seeing results is the defect this audit chain exists to catch.

claim_boundaries: Route A and Route B are NEVER merged into one ranking.
mimi_q8 and mimi_q32 are never merged; n_q on every row.
Numbers are ROUND TRIP (encoder+quantiser+decoder), attributed to the ROUTE, never to the decoder - except the E1 controlled pair.
Cross-arm ranking concerns 0-8 kHz fidelity only.
mcd is gain-INVARIANT: a ranking never implies level fidelity.
ORDERED, SEPARATION NOT ESTABLISHED where the interval includes zero or the effect is below the state's absolute floor.

metric_validity.estimand: Q9, GATE4_PREREG.md section 5 - the zero-parameter floor
metric_validity.preregistered_consequence: "A metric on which a 32-iteration Griffin-Lim reconstruction scores close to a trained neural codec is a metric that is not resolving what Gate 4 claims to resolve, and that is a finding about the metric."
metric_validity.VERDICT: ⛔ Q9 FIRES. THE SOLE PREREGISTERED CROSS-ARM RANKING METRIC FAILED ITS OWN VALIDITY CHECK IN ROUTE B.
metric_validity.measured: griffinlim, which has ZERO trained parameters, does not score close to the learned Route B decoders - it scores BEST, in 6 of 6 states
metric_validity.mechanism: mcd is a distance on the mel MAGNITUDE spectrum, and Griffin-Lim iteratively minimises exactly that quantity and has no other objective, while carrying phase error mcd cannot see. A metric cannot rank decoders on a quantity one of them is an optimiser for.
metric_validity.refuted_explanation: The hypothesis that mcd's -80 dB relative floor makes it dominated by low-level frames was TESTED AND REFUTED: on 25 matched Neutral cells, griffinlim leads in the LOUD half (67.6 vs bigvgan22 89.0) by MORE than in the quiet half (101.9 vs 117.9).
metric_validity.scope_limit: ⚠️ Q9's instrument exists ONLY in Route B. Route A has NO zero-parameter control, so this validity check has NOT BEEN RUN there. Under R13 that is NOT ESTABLISHED, which is NOT the same as unaffected.
metric_validity.no_metric_was_substituted: ⛔ No replacement metric was introduced after seeing this result. Choosing a ruler once the winner is known is the defect Q9 exists to catch.
metric_validity.consequence_for_every_route_A_ranking_be: Every SEPARATION ESTABLISHED verdict in this file rests on mcd, the metric that just failed Q9 in the other route. They are reported as the frozen protocol computes them, and they must not be quoted without this block.

metric_scale.construction: 80 mels, 24 cepstra, -80 dB RELATIVE floor, all frames
metric_scale.⛔ never: These are NOT literature-scale MCD. Never quote them against a published MCD figure, and never across routes.

ROBUST.meaning: both arms have broad support coverage, the pair carries >= 100 paired cells, and the INTERVAL - not merely the point estimate - clears the absolute floor

FLOOR_FRAGILE.meaning: ⚠️ well powered and directionally consistent, but the effect lies inside the instrument floor's OWN declared uncertainty, or some contributing state's interval misses that state's floor. Report the direction; do NOT report the magnitude as established.
FLOOR_FRAGILE.rule: SPEC S7.3 rule 2. NO PAIR IS NAMED IN CODE.

rule_2b_effect.note: a pair is in `determines_label_for` only if rule 2(b) ALONE moved it - it cleared the floor uncertainty and was still not robust. Rule 1 is tested first.

⛔ floor_hi_saturation.finding: floor_hi is the MAXIMUM of 16 fuzz draws exactly, in every state. The ROBUST/FLOOR_FRAGILE boundary is ONE EXTREME DRAW, not a distribution.
⛔ floor_hi_saturation.⚠️ read this before quoting the headline: the published ROBUST/FRAGILE split rests on these margins.

FLOOR_FRAGILE.floor_uncertainty_basis: GATE4_PREREG.md 6.1.4 limitation 5 already declares the floor to be a 0.95 quantile of 16 deterministic draws. Those frozen draws are bootstrapped (4000, seed 20260911) and the 97.5th percentile is floor_hi. Pooled (Scared): floor 105.0739, 95% CI [71.3740, 120.8091]. Every state is in `floor_uncertainty`. ⛔ floor_hi NEVER changes a verdict.

THIN_OR_SELECTION_CONDITIONED.meaning: ⛔ fewer than 100 paired cells, or at least one arm admitted on under 5% of its cells. The surviving cells are NOT a random sample - they are the cells where that arm happened to retain broadband energy, so the statistic is conditioned on the outcome.
THIN_OR_SELECTION_CONDITIONED.direction_of_bias: AGAINST the conclusion drawn: these are the low-coverage arm's most favourable cells and it still loses. The DIRECTION survives its own selection; the MAGNITUDE does not.

headline.1_metric_validity: The benchmark ran correctly and its sole preregistered cross-arm quality ruler FAILED ITS OWN PREREGISTERED VALIDITY CHECK in Route B (Q9). See metric_validity.

2_the_robust_quality_claim.claim: mimi_q8 is worse than 3 named arms under the strongest evidence class (SPEC S7.3 ROBUST)
2_the_robust_quality_claim.basis: n_paired >= 100, both arms' coverage >= 5.0%, the effect clears the instrument floor's OWN upper uncertainty bound, and EVERY contributing state's interval clears that state's floor

3_downgraded.claim: ⚠️ well powered and directionally consistent, but not in the strongest class. Report the DIRECTION, never the magnitude as established.
3_downgraded.history: Revision 2 called four mimi_q8 separations robust; the first audit (M5) directed one to FLOOR-FRAGILE and the author hardcoded that pair's NAME. SPEC S7.3.2 deletes the literal; this classification now comes from declared rules alone, and lands wherever they land.

headline.4_not_a_ranking_claim: Every number is a ROUND TRIP attributed to the ROUTE, never to a decoder. Route A and Route B never merge. mcd is gain-invariant, so no ranking implies level fidelity. These mcd values are NOT literature-scale MCD (80 mels, 24 cepstra, -80 dB relative floor, all frames). See metric_scale for the MEASURED range - it is not quoted here, it is computed.
